items.claim: I had usable parking data from 4 of 9 lots.
items.reason: Parking quality lists 4 usable lots out of 9 total.

items.claim: On a typical weekday, occupancy was lowest at 03:00 at 23.8% and highest at 12:00 at 48.6%.
items.reason: The parking typical weekday profile bottoms at 03:00 with 23.8% and peaks at 12:00 with 48.6%.

items.claim: Weekend behaviour differed by lot.
items.reason: The pooled parking test says weekend effects differ between series.

items.claim: Tiefgarage Hotel Maritim was emptier on weekends by 13.5 percentage points, and Tiefgarage Ulrichshaus was emptier by 15.0 percentage points.
items.reason: Both lots have significant negative weekend effects of 13.5 and 15.0 percentage points.

items.claim: Elbauenpark - Messeparkplatz and Tiefgarage Friedensplatz showed no measurable weekend change.
items.reason: Both listed lots have weekend_effect.significant set to false.

items.claim: Compared with August at the same hour and weekday, only Tiefgarage Friedensplatz was fuller, by 4.1 percentage points; its raw mean moved from 26.6% to 31.3%.
items.reason: Friedensplatz is the only parking lot with a significant positive adjusted shift, and its raw mean is 26.6% to 31.3%.

items.claim: Elbauenpark - Messeparkplatz, Tiefgarage Hotel Maritim and Tiefgarage Ulrichshaus showed no measurable change.
items.reason: All three listed lots have adjusted_shift.significant set to false.

items.claim: I had usable data from 17 of 18 charging stations.
items.reason: The EV charging quality data lists 18 stations in total and 17 usable ones.

items.claim: On a typical weekday, charging point occupancy was lowest at 03:00 at 6.7% and highest at 11:00 at 39.8%, then eased through the afternoon and evening.
items.reason: The typical weekday profile bottoms out at 03:00 with 6.7% and peaks at 11:00 with 39.8%, then is generally lower later in the day.

items.claim: Weekend behaviour did not look the same across stations, and most stations showed no measurable weekend change.
items.reason: The pooled test says weekend effects differ between stations, and only 2 of 17 stations have a significant weekend effect.

items.claim: Compared with August at the same hour and weekday, 4 stations were busier, 1 was less busy, and 10 showed no measurable change.
items.reason: The comparison summary shows 4 significantly higher, 1 significantly lower, and 10 with no significant change.

items.claim: The clearest rises were at Leipziger Straße 45, busier by 16.7 percentage points, with the raw mean moving from 9.1% to 25.6%, and Freiligrathstraße 1, busier by 14.7 percentage points, with the raw mean moving from 18.5% to 32.6%.
items.reason: These are the two largest adjusted increases among the comparable EV stations, and their previous and current means match.

items.claim: Hegelstraße 4 was the busiest station in September: no point was free for 34.5% of known time, and it was busier than in August by 13.9 percentage points.
items.reason: Hegelstraße 4 has the highest busy-all-points share and highest mean occupancy, and its adjusted shift versus August is +13.9 points.

items.claim: One station was less busy than in August, while the rest showed no measurable month-on-month change.
items.reason: FACTS says 1 station was less busy, 4 were busier, and 10 showed no significant change.

items.claim: For NO2, I had usable data from 4 stations.
items.reason: NO2 quality lists four usable stations.

items.claim: On a typical weekday, the median profile was lowest at 04:00 at 12.8 µg/m³ and highest at 21:00 at 30.0 µg/m³.
items.reason: The NO2 typical weekday trough is 04:00 at 12.8 and the peak is 21:00 at 30.0.

items.claim: At Guericke Strasse and Schleinufer, NO2 was lower on weekends by 5.1 and 5.9 µg/m³.
items.reason: Both stations have significant negative weekend effects of 5.1 and 5.9 µg/m³.

items.claim: City Tunnel and West showed no measurable weekend change.
items.reason: Both stations have weekend_effect.significant set to false.

items.claim: Compared with August at the same hour and weekday, all 4 NO2 stations showed no measurable change.
items.reason: All four NO2 stations are listed under no_significant_change.

items.claim: No NO2 station exceeded the EU hourly limit of 200 µg/m³.
items.reason: Each NO2 station has count_over 0 for the EU hourly limit.

items.claim: The WHO daily guideline of 25 µg/m³ was exceeded on 11 days at City Tunnel, 11 days at Schleinufer, 8 days at Guericke Strasse, and 1 day at West.
items.reason: The WHO daily exceedance counts are 11, 11, 8, and 1 for those stations.

items.claim: For O3, I had one usable station, West.
items.reason: West is the only usable O3 station.

items.claim: Its typical day was lowest at 08:00 at 36.4 µg/m³ and highest at 18:00 at 86.7 µg/m³.
items.reason: West's fitted O3 profile has a trough at 08:00 of 36.4 and a peak at 18:00 of 86.7.

items.claim: There was no measurable weekend change.
items.reason: West's O3 weekend effect is not significant.

items.claim: Compared with August at the same hour and weekday, O3 was cleaner by 15.3 µg/m³, with the raw mean moving from 73.4 to 58.3 µg/m³.
items.reason: West's adjusted shift is -15.3 µg/m³ with significant true, and its mean changed from 73.4 to 58.3.

items.claim: The EU 8-hour target of 120 µg/m³ was not exceeded, but the WHO 8-hour guideline of 100 µg/m³ was exceeded on 4 days.
items.reason: West has 0 days over the EU 8-hour target and 4 days over the WHO 8-hour guideline.

items.claim: I could not use PM10 this time: Guericke Strasse, Schleinufer and West were excluded because values were unchanged from the previous hour in 55%, 52% and 62% of hours.
items.reason: PM10 has no usable series, and those three are excluded for stale values at 55%, 52%, and 62%.

items.claim: I could not use PM2.5 either: Guericke Strasse, Schleinufer and West were excluded because values were unchanged from the previous hour in 64%, 63% and 70% of hours.
items.reason: PM2.5 has no usable series, and those three are excluded for stale values at 64%, 63%, and 70%.
